attributes.title: Gestures

lesson.concept: Related layers can share state without sharing one transition
lesson.why: The body and glow inherit hover and press variants. Scale uses a spring while colour and light use their own tweens, so a physical squeeze and a lighting response remain distinct.
lesson.experiment: Hold the globe under Rubber sun, release, then try Quiet pulse. Compare the shape response with how long the light takes to settle.
lesson.pitfall: Applying one generic transition to all properties removes the intentional difference between movement and illumination.
lesson.combine: Combine with a pointer follower, keeping keyboard focus and activation usable without hover.
